hook: Your sky and ground become one at Salar de Uyuni in Bolivia.
title: The Salt Flat That Turns Into A Mirror
description:
Salar de Uyuni in Bolivia is the world's largest salt flat. After rain, a thin layer of water covers the salt and reflects the sky like a giant mirror. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you walk here? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your sky and ground become one in Bolivia.
scenes.headline: SKY MEETS GROUND

scenes.narration: It is the largest salt flat in the world.
scenes.headline: WORLD'S BIGGEST SALT FLAT

scenes.narration: Most days, it is flat white salt.
scenes.headline: FLAT WHITE SALT

scenes.narration: Then rain covers it with a thin layer of water.
scenes.headline: THEN IT RAINS

scenes.narration: The water reflects the sky like a giant mirror.
scenes.headline: A GIANT MIRROR

scenes.narration: You cannot tell where the ground stops.
scenes.headline: NO HORIZON

scenes.narration: So here, you walk on the sky.
scenes.headline: WALK ON THE SKY

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: another place that should not exist.
scenes.headline: NEXT: ANOTHER IMPOSSIBLE PLACE
